services.title: AI Workflow Automation
services.lead: One focused flow of requests, decisions, routing, follow-ups, and system updates, running without anyone watching an inbox.
services.metaTitle: AI Workflow Automation for South Florida Businesses | DELAI
services.metaDesc: DELAI builds AI workflow automation for small and medium businesses in Miami, Fort Lauderdale, and Palm Beach County. Intake, triage, routing, and follow-up that runs itself.
services.overview: Most operational work is a queue. Something arrives, a person reads it, decides what it is, does three things in three different systems, and tries to remember to check back. We build that loop as software — AI does the reading and the deciding, your team handles the exceptions.

examples.d: Email, form, text, or voicemail becomes a classified, prioritized, assigned work order with the customer already notified.
Line items extracted, matched against the PO or the lease, flagged when they disagree, posted when they don't.
Nothing sits. The system chases vendors, customers, and internal owners on a schedule and escalates on age.
An inbox that sorts itself: routed by topic, drafted replies for the routine sixty percent, humans on the rest.

deliverables: A mapped workflow with every decision point named
Working automation running against your live systems
A human review step wherever being wrong is expensive
Logging and metrics: what it handled, what it escalated
signals: Work gets missed and the customer tells you first
The same five decisions get made forty times a week

services.title: Business Process Automation
services.lead: A larger end-to-end process redesigned across teams, steps, approvals, and systems — so the handoffs stop breaking.
services.metaTitle: Business Process Automation in Miami & Fort Lauderdale | DELAI
services.metaDesc: Business process automation for South Florida companies. DELAI rebuilds onboarding, close, approvals, and renewals as one connected operational flow.
services.overview: Some work isn't one task, it's fourteen — spread across five tools and three people, with a spreadsheet holding it together. Automating the pieces in isolation doesn't help. We rebuild the whole process as a single operational flow.

examples.d: New client, new tenant, new employee: documents collected, accounts created, systems provisioned, checklist tracked to completion.
Data pulled, reconciled, exceptions surfaced, owner and investor reports assembled and sent on the same day every month.
Thresholds, sign-offs, and audit trails enforced by the system instead of by memory.
Anything that happens every month or every year, running on its own calendar without a reminder from a person.

deliverables: A process map your team agrees is accurate
Automation across the systems you already use
Exception handling with clear ownership at each step
A live view of where every item currently sits
signals: The process lives in a spreadsheet and one person's head
Nobody can answer 'where is that right now?' without asking three people

services.title: AI Systems & Frameworks
services.lead: The shared AI foundation: knowledge, permissions, agents, evaluation, governance, and a private AI platform your team can actually log into.
services.metaTitle: AI Systems, Agents & Custom AI Platforms | DELAI South Florida
services.metaDesc: DELAI builds the shared AI foundation — knowledge architecture, agent frameworks, evaluation, governance, and custom AI platforms (your own private ChatGPT) — for businesses across Miami and Broward County.
services.overview: The second and third AI project is where most companies get into trouble: three assistants, three sets of rules, and no idea what any of them are actually allowed to do. We build the shared layer first, so everything after it is faster and safer.

examples.d: Your documents, policies, and records made retrievable and current, with answers that cite their source.
A defined set of actions AI is permitted to take, with limits, and every call logged.
Test sets and scoring, so you know whether a change made things better or worse before it ships.
Who can use what, on which data, with which approvals — enforced in code, not written in a policy doc.
A private AI platform for your team: it knows your business, runs on your data, and enforces your rules about who is allowed to ask what. Nothing leaves, and nothing is trained on you.

deliverables: A reference architecture specific to your business
Shared knowledge and retrieval layer
Permission and approval model
Evaluation harness and production monitoring
A private, branded AI platform your team signs into
signals: You have three AI pilots and no shared plan
Nobody can say what the AI is allowed to do
Data access questions keep stalling projects
Your team is pasting company information into a public chatbot

services.title: Internal AI Tools
services.lead: Focused applications that help your team finish specific operational work faster — one screen for the job they do fifty times a day.
services.metaTitle: Internal AI Tools & Custom Software | DELAI South Florida
services.metaDesc: Custom internal AI tools for South Florida businesses — review queues, quoting screens, ops consoles. Built by DELAI in Miami and Fort Lauderdale.
services.overview: Not another dashboard. A tool that does the specific thing — the review queue, the quoting screen, the reconciliation view — with AI reading, drafting, and pre-filling so the person is deciding instead of typing.

examples.d: AI drafts, a human approves, and the approval itself is the action that moves the work forward.
Pull the history, price the job, generate the document, send it — in one screen.
One box across leases, tickets, emails, and files, with answers that cite the document they came from.
The five things a coordinator needs, on one screen, instead of six browser tabs and a group chat.

deliverables: A working internal application, deployed
Single sign-on and role-based access
AI assistance built into the task, not bolted onto it
Usage data so you know it's actually being used
signals: Your team lives in six tabs and a spreadsheet
Training a new hire takes a month because the process is tribal

services.title: Customer-Facing AI Applications
services.lead: Portals, assistants, and self-service experiences your customers use directly — and that hold up.
services.metaTitle: Customer-Facing AI Applications | AI Development in Miami | DELAI
services.metaDesc: DELAI designs and builds customer-facing AI applications — portals, support assistants, and intake flows — for small and medium businesses in South Florida.
services.overview: Customer-facing AI has a higher bar: it has to be right, it has to know when to hand off, and it has to sound like you. We build the ones that reduce inbound volume instead of generating angry follow-ups.

examples.d: Customers get status, documents, and answers without opening a ticket or calling the office.
Answers what it knows, escalates everything else cleanly, with full context attached.
Prospects and requests captured, qualified, and routed the moment they arrive — including at 11pm.
Software you sell, not only software you run internally.

deliverables: A production application under your brand
Defined escalation paths to real people
Content and tone controls you own
Analytics on deflection, satisfaction, and failure cases
signals: The same twenty questions arrive every single day
Customers call because they can't see status anywhere
Response time is your most common complaint

services.title: Connected Operational Systems
services.lead: CRM, accounting, ticketing, inventory, and spreadsheets connected so information and actions actually move between them.
services.metaTitle: System Integration & Connected Operations | DELAI South Florida
services.metaDesc: DELAI connects the systems South Florida businesses already run — CRM, accounting, ticketing — into one operational layer with a real source of truth.
services.overview: Most 'AI problems' are integration problems wearing a costume. If the data lives in four places and none of them agree, no model fixes that. We connect the systems, settle which one is authoritative, and keep them in sync.

examples.d: Two-way sync between the tools you already pay for, with conflict rules that match how you actually operate.
One customer record, one property record, one source of truth — and a documented reason why.
Numbers that match across systems because they're coming from the same place.
The old system nobody is replacing this year, connected to everything else anyway.

deliverables: Integration layer between your core systems
Documented data model and system of record
Monitoring and alerting for sync failures
Reporting built on unified data
signals: You export CSVs to make anything work together
Two systems give two different answers to the same question
Your reporting process is a person, not a report
